current_evidence: The council's 'Making a planning application' page still links this 'Local validation checklist for major applications' alongside 11 other type-specific checklists (minor/householder/full, LDC, NMA, adverts, LBC, telecoms, demolition, S73, conditions, TPO), and searches found no newer H&F local list. Neither the PDF text nor the page shows a date.

issues.detail: The workbook link is only the majors checklist, which covers 10+ dwellings or non-residential buildings/extensions of 1,000 sqm or more. Most applications use the separate 'Minor, householder and full application' checklist (validation_checklist_minor_householder_and_full_applications_21.06.17_1.pdf), which covers 1-9 dwellings and non-residential buildings or changes of use under 1,000 sqm. Grokbot read it but did not use it for any application-type row.
issues.evidence: Making-a-planning-application page link list: 'Minor, householder and full application' ... 'Local validation checklist for major applications'

issues.detail: The List date 2018-04-01 comes from PDF metadata. No date appears in the document text or on the council page. The filename indicates 10.04.2018 (10 April 2018), the minor/householder checklist is 21.06.17, and the other type checklists are labelled 'updated October 2018'.
issues.evidence: Filename 'validation_checklist_major_applications_10.04.2018.pdf'; PDF text shows no date

issues.detail: The trigger excerpts are systematically offset by one question. Each row quotes 'If yes, [this document]...' followed by the NEXT question, so the trigger shown belongs to a different requirement. Air Quality shows the Class B1 employment-loss question; its real trigger is 'affect or be affected by air pollution'. Tree survey shows the contamination question; its real trigger is building works within 5m of a tree's crown spread. Daylight/sunlight shows the tree question; its real trigger is impact on light to a neighbouring property. Design and Access Statement shows the flood-zone question; its real trigger is 1+ dwellings, 100 sqm+, or affecting a listed building or conservation area. Travel plan shows the plant/noise question; its real trigger is a substantial increase in pedestrian/vehicle trips. The same offset affects the Listed building consent rows.
issues.evidence: Air Quality row: 'If yes, an air quality assessment should be provided Question 13: ... Will the proposal involve a change of use or redevelopment that will lose Class B1...'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment row gives no trigger. The source requires an FRA where the site is in EA Flood Zone 2 or 3, or a surface water flooding hotspot (minor checklist), and the proposal relates to a basement and/or ground floor level. Majors-only Part 3 items have no threshold in Grokbot: Sustainability statement with energy assessment, SuDS, Transport statement, Statement of Community Involvement, viability report and biodiversity survey. They apply only to majors (10+ dwellings, or non-residential/extensions of 1,000 sqm+).
issues.evidence: 'Is your proposal within the Environmental Agency Flood zone 2 or 3 and relate to a basement and/or ground floor level?'; 'Part 3: Major Developments'

issues.detail: Householder is shown as '(none)'. The 'Minor, householder and full applications' checklist that Grokbot read applies 17 local questions to householder applications. They include the DAS (in a listed building or conservation area context), FRA, basement construction statement, daylight/sunlight, tree survey, land contamination, transport assessment, travel plan, noise, refuse, lighting, odour, air quality, marketing, heritage statement, accessibility statement and demolition-in-conservation-area documents.
issues.evidence: Minor/householder/full checklist Part 2 Q1-Q17; scope 'householder, minor and full applications'

issues.detail: Every Full planning row comes from the majors checklist, so non-major full applications are shown with major-only requirements: SCI, Sustainability/energy statement, SuDS, Transport statement and viability report. Under Outline, Grokbot placed the TPO tree-works checklist's arboriculturalist report and the prior-notification-for-demolition checklist's 'Demolition method statement', neither of which is an outline requirement. The same demolition item appears under 'Change of use - prior approval', which is a different prior approval. It is also mislabelled 'Schedule of works (listed building)'.
issues.evidence: Outline row source: validation_checklist_tree_works_updated_october_2018.pdf and validation_checklist_prior_notification_for_demolition_updated_october_2018.pdf; excerpt 'blue Demolition method statement'

issues.detail: Some requirements are not captured as application-type rows. Basement construction statement: Q3, for a new basement or lowering, enlarging or externally altering one, in both checklists. Transport assessment: minor checklist Q7, where the proposal changes vehicle movements to, from or around the site. Draft construction plan and draft logistics plan: majors Part 3. Financial viability declaration form: required with any financial viability report, per the planning page. Demolition management plan and annotated demolition plans: required for demolition in a conservation area. These appear only as garbled tab_items, not as requirement rows.
issues.evidence: 'Does your proposal involve the construction of a new basement...' -> 'Construction statement for basements'; majors Part 3 'Draft construction plan', 'Draft logistics plan'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent, LDC, Non-material amendment, S73 variation and Discharge of conditions are all '(none)', yet Grokbot lists the council's type-specific checklists for each (all 'updated October 2018') in docs_read. Those checklists were not mapped to their types. They were not re-checked item by item because the shared web-fetch budget ran out. Grokbot's LBC rows include CIL forms, SCI, Transport statement, Travel plan and Air quality, which are unusual for listed building consent; these could not be re-verified against the LBC checklist for the same reason.
issues.grok_comment: The type checklists are mapped as '(none)'. They do list a few local items, e.g. LDC "Evidence verifying information", S73 "Statement describing the variation" and NMA "Schedule of alterations". But the doubt about the LBC rows is unfounded: the captured LBC checklist (raw cc40daee60) itself lists the SCI, Transport statement and air quality items.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The (none) rows for LDC, s73 and NMA stand; the doubt about the LBC rows is withdrawn.

issues.detail: The council's checklists date from 2017-2018 and are out of date in content. They refer to Class B1 (abolished in September 2020) and omit the statutory Biodiversity Net Gain and Fire Statement requirements. They are, however, still the lists the council links. Grokbot correctly flags 'Outdated (>2y)' as Yes.
issues.evidence: Q13/Q14: 'lose Class B1 or other employment generating used'

issues.detail: The tab_item 'Download the Community Infrastructure Levy form (pdf) Section 106 agreement These agreements are normally to offset the impact of large-scale developments...' is explanatory web text. The demolition tab_items begin with checkbox fragments ('If yes: □', 'N If yes:') and end with 'Part 3:'. The 'Pre-application advice' rows (Full and LBC) are advice to seek pre-app, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Applicants should seek pre-application advice on any significant proposal...'

issues.detail: The same source items are counted twice. 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' both stand for the single 'biodiversity survey and report' (Q3). 'Photographs / Photomontages' and 'Heritage Statement' share the same demolition excerpt ('A heritage statement including photographs'). 'Floor plans / Elevations' cites only the elevations line.
issues.evidence: Both rows quote 'If yes, a biodiversity survey and report should be provided'

summary: Grokbot's link works and is still the council's current (2018, undated in text) majors checklist, but it is one of 12 type-specific H&F checklists, and the main minor/householder/full checklist was ignored, leaving Householder as '(none)'. Trigger excerpts are systematically offset by one question, so each row shows another requirement's trigger. Key items such as the basement construction statement and construction/logistics plans are missing, and outline/prior approval rows are misassigned.
